template:
Hi,

Noticed that you handle {{business_type}} in {{city}}.

We help {{business_type}} companies generate 10 qualified {{inspection_type}} that can convert into {{project_type}} projects, in under 30 days.

There's no pay unless I book you a qualified, confirmed inspection.

Open to a 15-minute chat?

instructions.business_type: the trade this company leads with on its website, lowercase, 2-3 words, chosen from: foundation repair, basement waterproofing, crawl space repair, concrete leveling, house leveling, slab repair. Use the one they put first, not the one they list among many.
instructions.inspection_type: what this company calls its first visit to a homeowner, plural, 2-4 words, matching their own wording, e.g. foundation inspections, free basement inspections, crawl space inspections, concrete lifting estimates.
instructions.project_type: what this company calls the paid job that follows, 1-3 words, e.g. foundation repair, waterproofing, crawl space encapsulation, concrete lifting.
instructions.city: ONLY if the 'city' known fact is blank: the city this company is based in, from the website. Otherwise repeat the known city exactly.
